## OWNER DECISION — #380 D3 BOUNDED TEST-ONLY COMPARATIVE PROOF GO (2026-10-13)

**ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT — no release timetable, no historical publicly released client compatibility requirement.** This is an **explicit TEST-ONLY implementation authorization** for one independent Codex Cloud Draft PR. It is NOT permission to implement a production schema, new IPC, Windows Service, Global Index Coordinator, database write path, retry/backpressure policy or installer. #393 remains DIAGNOSTIC / MERGE HOLD; #386 D1-A and #388 generation publication are NOT approved bases. Do not merge these candidates to start D3.

**Verified inputs immediately before authorization**:
- master `3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97`, Tree `009576241cd4e8e2ba12cc644a368314f599faa6`; refresh before work.
- [PR #393](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/393) HEAD `0532e0ddee5c65a3ae98f5722512d2a2faed16ee`, Tree `05c6bc098c4dc51a6c78f4c17c721064ab426d7d`, 3 files +294/-0 test-only, [exact-head CI 38370966279](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/actions/runs/38370966279) SUCCESS 13/14 success/skipped. Its tests characterize the BUG, not a fix.
- [Full Owner architecture contract](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/issues/380#issuecomment-6142561334) and [source-grounded final review](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/issues/380#issuecomment-6142385721).
- Newly open #381-B2 [PR #395](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/395) is separate. No shared prototype or schema assumptions without new Owner decision.

### Why compare, rather than decree IPC v4

Current `coordinator.rs:218-256` user Rebuild mutates persistent health and whole-volume entries *before* any Service request is admitted. `repository.rs:341-367` propagates staleness to Global/Managed/AI rows through separate statements. `coordinator.rs:545-563,638-662` writes speculative status and late error; `repository.rs:207-241` has no monotonic owner CAS. WorkScheduler resource lease is *not* Service busy reservation (`service_host.rs:195-278`). `windows/service.rs:258-291` currently does not bind incoming response/event frames to the requesting protocol/request ID at the consume boundary. `windows/mod.rs:333-455` commits streamed sink effects and may Direct fallback after transport error. **The existing IPC v3 contains request IDs on frames, but has no proved explicit Service Offer/Grant handshake.**

**Compare three scoped approaches with the SAME independent reference oracle and adversarial schedule:**

- **A — No new wire: defer all source/data writes; enforce request-ID-bound incoming frames; first verified event or terminal completion attempts a SQLite source-owner CAS before any DB sink effect.** Rebuild intent is durable and independently represented. If Service work begins before client DB claim, demonstrate that it cannot mutate durable user/index truth by any path. Treat loss of transport after possibly committed events as UNKNOWN and **never** automatically Direct-replay. PROVE all events are safely fenced. An absence of a first event and a late terminal result need explicit tests.
- **B — Explicit admission offer/grant (research-model wire only):** Service reserves busy slot, validates source and sends offer; client claims DB owner, acknowledges grant; only then may Service stream actionable events. Prove service-instance/request/source/revision bound token, expired offer, duplicate/late frames, restart and grant-loss. This is a model, **not a decision to add IPC v4**.
- **C — One process/database writer arbiter under existing caller/control surface:** serialize committed source state and effects, keep Rebuild intent durable. Prove its actual authority across Service, Direct and wake/restart. A Mutex in one desktop or a scheduler lease by itself is **not** global OS/process ownership. Reject C if it cannot fence independent processes or if it simply recreates the original early-write race.

### Shared source/data invariants (tests cannot weaken)

1. **Distinct:** user RebuildIntent, Service admission/operation, committed SourceHealth, published entry/Managed/AI state. Persisted `REBUILD_REQUIRED` as a *real fault* must survive rejected requests; a user pending Rebuild is not proof of fault.
2. Busy (zero admitted events) leaves pre-existing health/error, `global_entries.is_stale`, Managed/AI flags, counters and checkpoints **unchanged**; only standalone durable PendingIntent may change.
3. If an intent must survive restart, demonstrate durable write+replay/coalesce/cancel (not an in-memory-only flag). Never infer Rebuild intent by overwriting committed status.
4. All committed source effects use CAS owner/revision or an equivalent actually exclusive persistent writer. Time string, status equality, or second-resolution updated_at are NOT safe ABA fences.
5. Fenced events must carry request/source/owner authority; an arriving event from an earlier owner is rejected **before** side effects. No query/update split race and no orphan side effects.
6. Whole-volume stale, index counts, Managed Entries and AI invalidation are coupled to a single admitted owner and a crash-consistent visibility/repair story; if the model cannot provide this with existing immediate mutation, mark the approach **BLOCKED** (do not fake an atomic epoch).
7. Direct fallback inherits the SAME source owner, not its own competing owner. Transport UNKNOWN after possible event => fail-closed/reconcile, not auto replay.
8. A faithful v3 protocol/ID mismatch, unknown code, unexpected frame, lookup mismatch or source mismatch fails closed. Keep SQLite BUSY(5), paused, permission, genuine provider/IO distinct from `index_service_busy`.
9. Never infer false READY after a failed/partial run. Preserve the prior trusted visible snapshot or explicitly mark incomplete/reconciliation while retaining all user annotations. Do not falsely claim full old-or-new snapshot if the candidate model only protects status.

### Bounded D3 test contracts

**Required D3-T01..T14**: (01) Start busy; (02) Resume busy; (03) Rebuild(one) busy; (04) Rebuild(all) mixed sources; (05) offer/grant or first-event CAS fails; (06) duplicate and coalesced intent after restart; (07) late busy/old response vs READY, PermissionRequired, true RebuildRequired and ERROR; (08) identical-status ABA with different revision; (09) forged/stale request ID, version, source ID and lookup ID; (10) zero-event successful terminal result; (11) pause/cancel/restart before offer, after offer, after grant and after first effect; (12) partial stream + transport UNKNOWN and no Direct replay; (13) known no-effect Direct transfer with one writer; (14) index rows/Managed/AI/counter/checkpoint integrity plus real SQLITE_BUSY-vs-service_busy separation.

**Must-be-rejected negative cases N01..N06**: naive `skip busy ERROR`; blind source/status restoration; pre-admission mass stale; stale event/ABA after newer owner; transport UNKNOWN followed by Direct; fake scheduler lease mistaken as Service admission. Each negative control needs a genuinely observable failing invariant and `expected_rejection_observed=true` in raw evidence.

Use deterministic barriers/process restart, temporary SQLite (Python stdlib SQLite allowed) and separate independent oracle; no timer/sleep as correctness proof. Contrast all three alternatives in one table: passed/blocked invariants, minimal source edit surface, durable data requirement, IPC field/protocol requirement, native-test gaps, performance/locking risks. If option A passes everything, DO NOT recommend B merely for sophistication; if none passes, return exact blockers and the smallest architectural decision needed.

### Exact scope and deliverable

Suggested branch: `test/issue-380-d3-admission-owner-oracle`. New files **ONLY** under `tests/issue380_d3/**` and `docs/project/research/issue-380-d3/**`; no existing file edits at all. Do NOT modify `src-tauri/**`, `src/**`, existing tests, Cargo/npm locks, .github, Schema, IPC, Service, Coordinator, Index Scope, AI, CI routing or thresholds. The current Windows Owner machine is acceptance-only; do all Codex work in Codex Cloud.

Deliver standalone runnable harness + independent reference oracle + one human review report + raw case JSON (including intentional failures) + source and fixture hashes + real environment, SQLite source/version, command/exit codes, exact base/HEAD/Tree and Diff. Keep artifacts proportional (no 27 binary DB snapshots in Git just to inflate evidence). Natural PR CI only; do not dispatch manual Full Validation, 100k/500k/1m work or Codex Review. Linux SQLite model is **not** native Service/SCM or product SQLite qualification.

**STOP:** create an **OPEN/Draft PR** and stop at `ISSUE_380_D3_COMPARATIVE_TEST_ONLY_READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW` ONLY if every T01-T14 passes for at least one fully scoped safe approach, all N01-N06 are correctly rejected, and alternatives are honestly classified; else `D3_CONTRACT_BLOCKED` with smallest remaining gap. No production GO, merge, Issue close, master edit, schema version assignment, public release or claim #380 FIX READY.

Next after independent review: Owner chooses minimal production implementation scope; no unbounded additional research phase by default.

## OWNER #380 — ADMISSION, REBUILD INTENT AND SOURCE OWNERSHIP ARCHITECTURE (2026-10-13)

**STATUS: DESIGN_READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW / PR393_DIAGNOSTICS_ACCEPTED / PRODUCTION_FIX_NO_GO / D3_TEST_ONLY_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED / ACTIVE_DEVELOPMENT.**

**Pinned facts**: master 3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97 (Tree 009576241cd4e8e2ba12cc644a368314f599faa6); [Draft PR #393](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/393) HEAD 0532e0ddee5c65a3ae98f5722512d2a2faed16ee / Tree 05c6bc098c4dc51a6c78f4c17c721064ab426d7d (3 files +294/-0, test-only). [Exact-head CI run 38370966279](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/actions/runs/38370966279) SUCCESS 13 successful, 14 skipped; Windows/macOS blocker characterization tests passed and show the **existing defect**, not repaired behavior.

**Source-verified owner blockers**:
1. Coordinator public rebuild at src-tauri/src/global_index/coordinator.rs:218-256 persists REBUILD_REQUIRED, clears prior error, and stales whole-volume entries **before** actual Windows Service admission.
2. repository.rs:341-367 whole-volume stale also updates managed_entries, AI jobs/items, analysis state, entry_count in separate statements, without an explicit full-sequence transaction. This is not safely compensatable by a status-only rollback.
3. coordinator.rs:545-563,638-662 speculatively writes INDEXING/SYNCING and unconditionally rewrites late error/cause. repository.rs:207-241 is UPDATE ... WHERE id only: **no owner/revision CAS**. Its separate source_revision is a read projection, not a write fence.
4. coordinator.rs:685-715 WorkScheduler lease is only **resource admission**, not Windows Service admission. Windows service_host.rs:195-278 owns independent busy.compare_exchange and may reject the request without any sink work.
5. windows/service.rs:258-291 call/call_stream currently returns or applies frames before incoming protocol/request_id comparison at that boundary; existing v3 has no proved separate offer/grant ACK. windows/mod.rs:333-455 applies streaming events to sink and on transport failure marks UNAVAILABLE then Direct-fallbacks: an UNKNOWN partly applied stream cannot be safely Direct-replayed.

**Accepted architecture semantics (research, NOT code authorization)**:

- **Layer A — Rebuild Intent**: durable, idempotent/coalesced pending/deferred/claimed/cancelled/completed request with per-source scope; it is distinct from committed SourceHealth. Existing true REBUILD_REQUIRED fault causes remain health, not retroactively relabeled user intent. On rejected-busy, only the pending-intent audit may change; old committed health, entries, managed AI, checkpoint and error stay intact.
- **Layer B — Actual Service/Direct admission**: candidate test-only protocol **Service reserve + source validation -> identity-bound AdmissionOffer -> client DB-owner CAS -> Client Grant -> first actionable stream**. Bind request ID, protocol, source ID and operation token, reject wrong/missing/out-of-order frames. This two-phase protocol **is not existing IPC v3 functionality**. Compare a strictly proved smaller alternative; if none, propose an explicit new wire/version and linked Desktop/Service qualification. No public legacy-client matrix exists (product has never shipped).
- **Layer C — Committed source health**: each write of status/cause/checkpoint/full/incremental time is owned by a monotonic source revision and operation token, or a rigorously proven equivalent single-writer authority. Both current and later owners must be fenced, including discovery/provider/enabled changes by their separate owners. Never do optimistic stale-health writes followed by blind restoration, and never infer state safety from equal status/timestamps (ABA).
- **Layer D — Published entry and derivatives**: sink, global entries, managed state, AI job invalidation, counters and search-visible membership require the same conditional operation identity plus a crash-safe publication/recovery boundary. No destructive writes before admission; if an admitted stream is partially committed, expose truthful degraded/reconciliation state and retain durable user/entry data rather than claiming READY.
- **Direct fallback shares the same DB source owner**. Only a proven no-effect and fully released Service path may transfer to Direct. If there might have been partial events, fail closed; no replay. Real SQLite BUSY(5) #328 remains distinct from the Service request-busy #380. Managed Scan #381 remains independently governed.

**Explicitly rejected:** ServiceBusy enum + skip ERROR alone; blind snapshot/row restoration after rejected busy; arbitrary first event or scheduler lease as admission; in-memory-only user Rebuild intent with no restart story; generic busy_timeout inflation; speculative broker/legacy K1/K2/G1 pre-release upgrade buildout.

**Required repaired tests R01–R14 (NOT DONE):** strict typed/unknown-code decode; inbound v3/new-wire request/response/event identity; busy Start; busy Resume; busy Rebuild(one) no earlier stale/AI/error; Rebuild(all) per-source isolation; offer but no DB grant; repeated/cross-source pending; late busy with READY/PermissionRequired/RebuildRequired/ERROR; same-status ABA; pause/cancel/restart; partial stream/transport break and Direct no-replay; legitimate isolated Direct authority; genuine SQLite BUSY and true Provider/permission/IO errors kept intact. Keep old PR393 characterization tests and show red-before/green-after.

**Crash/interrupt cut points to prove:** before intent commit; after durable Pending; Service busy rejection; Service reserved before Client grant; failed DB CAS; grant before first event; partial stream; old response after newer owner; restart/pause; Direct fallback. Must prove old-or-new owner truth with no ghost source READY or hidden data destruction.

**Owner direction**: prefer testing the semantic combination *durable intent + explicit admissible operation + monotonic source owner conditional updates* before considering production implementation. Whether new Schema/IPC is strictly needed remains OPEN. The current product is unreleased and in active development; choose simple correct latest-version architecture, not fictitious customer upgrade obligations.

**Full detailed Owner artifact created in the conversation:** Zen_Canvas_380_Service_Admission_与状态所有权架构合同_2026-10-13.md (not in repo). The issue comment is a self-contained executable design brief; an independent D3 test-only PR requires a new bounded Owner GO. No Schema v38 allocated, no production code/CI/IPC changes, master mutation, PR merge, Issue close, Release, Windows local development or Codex Review.

## OWNER FINAL EXACT-HEAD REVIEW — #393 DIAGNOSTIC ACCEPTED; #380 PRODUCTION REMEDIATION STOP (2026-10-13)

**Independent final verification after Codex completion:** [PR #393](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/393) remains OPEN/Draft, final HEAD `0532e0ddee5c65a3ae98f5722512d2a2faed16ee`, Git Tree `05c6bc098c4dc51a6c78f4c17c721064ab426d7d`. Starting master `3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97` / Tree `009576241cd4e8e2ba12cc644a368314f599faa6`, HEAD ahead 4 behind 0. Diff **3 files +294/-0**, only one cfg(test) coordinator include, one test-only Windows decoder bridge, one diagnostic tests module. **Zero production fix.**

**Natural final CI** [38370966279](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/actions/runs/38370966279), attempt 1, completed **SUCCESS: 13 successful jobs and 14 conditionally skipped, no failed/cancelled jobs**. Independently inspected job logs: the two `issue380_ownership_blocker_*` characterization tests ran and PASS on both Windows Rust quality and macOS Rust quality. Windows qualification job checks out exact candidate HEAD. Merge-integration jobs use GitHub test merge `eaf9ca2618a3a50c53ec0fd6ade63d17d671a3b7` (same product/content tree as final head due to frozen master); this is recorded as merge-integration, not falsely described as a native Owner product PASS. Historical cancelled workflows and earlier clippy failure remain in the PR history. True Windows native Service/SCM Owner acceptance and 14 repaired-behavior tests **NOT_RUN / NOT_COMPLETED**.

**Root cause CONFIRMED from exact master:**
1. `coordinator.rs:218-256` public `rebuild` changes `global_volumes` source status/error and calls mass stale **BEFORE** Service admission. `repository.rs:341-367` mass stale also updates `global_entries`, `managed_entries`, `ai_jobs`, `ai_job_items`, `ai_analysis_state` and count, across multiple SQL statements, not a single confirmed atomic logical publication contract.
2. `coordinator.rs:545-563` writes speculative `SYNCING/INDEXING` ahead of provider; `:638-662` overwrites committed status/error after busy. `repository.rs:207-241` uses unconditional `WHERE id=?1` — no state owner/revision. `source_revision` is an independent diagnostic/read hash, **not** a write CAS.
3. `coordinator.rs:685-715` **WorkScheduler background admission is NOT Windows Service request admission**. The Service checks `service_host.rs:195-203,262-278` its own `busy.compare_exchange` and can return `index_service_busy` without sink events. The client `windows/mod.rs:406-423` currently only learns this via a terminal response, while streaming events can mutate a sink earlier in admitted paths. Therefore obtaining WorkScheduler lease or entering provider method **cannot** justify destructive pre-admission database changes.
4. `windows/service.rs:258-291` existing `call` and `call_stream` return/dispatch frames at that boundary without verifying inbound `protocol_version` / request_id against the active request. Trusted typed busy/error handling must preserve strict frame identity and no message-string heuristics.
5. #328 true SQLite DB BUSY is separate from Service request-level `index_service_busy`, and #381 Managed Scan is a separate DB authority/FTS scope. No public legacy installed base exists: K1/K2/G1 legacy upgrade blockers are not part of this task.

**OWNER ARCHITECTURE DECISION — choose intent/health separation plus bounded conditional ownership, not a blind restoration algorithm.**

- Separate: (a) durable/replayable **RebuildIntent** (selection, source scope, coalescing and cancellation), (b) actual **Service admission reservation**, (c) committed source health/progress/checkpoint **owned by one operation**, and (d) searchable entry/Managed-AI publication state. A *pending intent is not RebuildRequired health*. Rejection with no admitted sink events must leave committed health/data unchanged while reporting intent pending or cancellation accurately.
- A merely in-memory intent is insufficient if restart must preserve user-requested Rebuild; determine whether existing durable source fields can represent intent **without destructively repurposing health**. If no safe mapping, explicitly propose a minimal persisted intent record and revision in a separately approved schema contract; do not assume v38 or IPC v4.
- Conditional writer ownership **must** fence all committed health and downstream effects, not only busy->ERROR; monotonic source/operation revision/owner token OR a provable single-writer serializing mechanism; all writers must be inventoried narrowly. `updated_at` and read hash are not authority. Older/late results or an ABA state must not overwrite a newer owner.
- Existing streaming wire may lack explicit admission ACK. Define an exact Service-admission event/contract before any destructive transition. If no evidence possible under current v3 shape, stop for protocol scope decision; never conflate scheduling lease with Service acceptance.
- Stale entries and managed AI/FTS/volume-count changes need an atomic/protected lifecycle and crash/recovery semantics; do not prewrite stale and then blindly compensate after rejected busy.

**NEXT OWNER GATE (design-only; no product code GO):** construct a bounded source-grounded request intent/health/entry event-state diagram with all caller/DB writer paths, IPC admission alternatives preserving current v3 if feasible, exact interrupt/restart/late busy/in-flight partial progress behavior, options comparison (no-prewrite vs monotonic owner revision vs combined), minimum required schema/IPC and compatibility implications for **unreleased active development only**, and a list of deterministic 14 repaired tests. Then return an Owner-signed explicit change scope before Codex Cloud production implementation. Do not resume the old narrow fix as if typing an error alone solved the defect.

**Disposition:** `#393_TEST_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC_EVIDENCE_ACCEPTED / CI_EXACT_HEAD_SUCCESS / #393_DRAFT_MERGE_HOLD / #380_OWNER_ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT_REQUIRED / PRODUCTION_FIX_NOT_READY / MASTER_UNCHANGED / ACTIVE_DEVELOPMENT`.

No merge, close, release, v38 allocation, workflow/threshold relaxation, redundant CI dispatch, Windows Owner-machine development or Codex Review.
